lead_raw_text:
The structure of MnCoS4 crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms (Mn4Co4S16) distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mn and Co centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six S neighbors, while S adopts a tetrahedral motif with two Co and two Mn neighbors. Corner-sharing is observed between Mn–Co, Mn–Mn, and Co–Co octahedra, alongside edge-sharing between S tetrahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites.
